command_or_source: App commit 763fdaafb43976b33613989140a9acb0338cd681: bash scripts/test.sh (testTocodeCommandExecutorMapping, testTocodeCLIRunnerAndIPC, testWeChatCommandConsumption).
result_summary: Memory IPC transport drives the full CLI runner-to-executor chain; WeChat mock sends .lshp, .blackout, and plain messages and asserts command execution plus no wechat*.md writes for command messages, with cursor and dedupe advancing exactly once.
limitations: WeChat command routing uses a mock transport and archiver rather than the real iLink client.
